description.zh:
告警事件的唯一标识。

> 查询警事件的详细信息，需要提供告警事件的唯一标识信息，该标识信息可调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the alert event.

> To query the details of an alert event, you must provide the unique identifier of the alert event. You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain the identifier.
The ID of the request source. Set the value to **sas**.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English
The source IP address of the request.

title.zh: 获取告警事件详细信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-alarm-event-detail --source-ip 192.168.XX.XX --lang zh --alarm-unique-info 9f62555666f177aa84ee1eaf465a0000 --from sas --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeAlarmEventDetail --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '192.168.XX.XX' --AlarmUniqueInfo 9f62555666f177aa84ee1eaf465a0000 --Lang zh --From sas
